svg.title: Client watcher: every day, it checks what Claude Code, Codex and Cursor changed
svg.desc: Three columns: you, a model, and the bots and scripts. Fetch, 05:17 UTC: new parts of the release notes and docs of the three clients; Claude Sonnet 5.5: checks every row of Kitden's list, with a quote; Reads Kitden's code: gives a type and a severity: major, medium or minor; A second look: checks a sure break or wrong data again; Lantern: a sure major one: an issue at once, two a week at most; the rest: Monday's summary; Confirm it: or close it as a false alarm.
